objective:
Discover new mechanisms in which TRAINING-ONLY user behaviour and HYPERBOLIC geometry are computationally coupled to improve the RQ-VAE Semantic IDs used by a generative next-item recommender, with the real target of Stage3 test Recall@10 above 0.065.

The three mechanisms this issue has tried since the branch-curvature round - a behaviour-ranked radius in the Poincare score (BRad-RQ), a successor-overlap ranking in the ball, and a per-item branching curvature - all improved the SID diagnostics (hard L1 error 1.86-2.5 against the 16.4 baseline, 6-15k two-level prefixes against 16145) and none of them moved test_recall@10 above the 0.0553 baseline: the best was 0.0446. Proposals in this round must state, in the observables, what makes THIS coupling different in the mechanism that Stage 3 actually learns from, not in the identifier statistics: which quantity the generative model reads from the prefix, and why the measured behaviour statistic makes that quantity carry information the history does not already contain. A proposal whose only claimed benefit is a better L1/L2/L3 diagnostic is out of scope for this round.
